method: Agent visual inspection of actual images with view_image; ffprobe and SHA256 validation
findings: Both models, all legs and floor grid visible; no blank frames or major cropping at inspected start/mid/end frames.
Comparison labels identify old PPO + DR on left and PPO + DR + heading on right; time, displacement and world-frame heading HUD readable.
Both first episodes run 10 seconds at real-time playback and finish by timeout with no fall.
Exact initial root/joint state and random physical parameter snapshots match across both policies.
limitations: Single preselected seed42 live-policy episode is an illustration; conclusions must use the separate multi-seed evaluation.
